alarm.1.help: Below 5 °C for ten minutes. See the troubleshooting section of the manual, or book a service.
alarm.1.name: Cold supply air after recovery
alarm.10.help: A fault reported by the heat recovery.
alarm.10.name: Heat recovery
alarm.11.help: A fault reported by the cooling.
alarm.11.name: Cooling
alarm.12.help: The external emergency stop input is active. The alarm clears only once acknowledged.
alarm.12.name: External emergency stop
alarm.13.help: The external fire-risk input is active. The alarm clears only once acknowledged.
alarm.13.name: External fire risk
alarm.14.help: Time to look the unit over and change the filters.
alarm.14.name: Service reminder
alarm.15.name: Pressure switch PDS10
alarm.16.help: The differential pressure switch reports a blocked filter. Change the supply filter.
alarm.16.name: Dirty supply filter
alarm.17.help: The differential pressure switch reports a blocked filter. Change the extract filter.
alarm.17.name: Dirty extract filter
alarm.18.help: Not used on this type of unit.
alarm.18.name: Supply filter, low
alarm.19.help: Not used on this type of unit.
alarm.19.name: Extract filter, low
alarm.2.help: Below 10 °C for ten minutes. The unit goes into its fault mode: supply off, extract at minimum.
alarm.2.name: Cold supply air
alarm.20.name: Supply fan — pressure
alarm.21.name: Extract fan — pressure
alarm.22.name: TE50 high
alarm.24.name: TE52 high
alarm.25.name: Supply fan — rotation
alarm.26.name: Extract fan — rotation
alarm.27.name: TE02 high
alarm.28.name: Service reminder — constant duct pressure
alarm.3.help: Above 55 °C. The unit stops. Call service and find the cause before acknowledging it.
alarm.3.name: Fire risk — hot supply air
alarm.4.help: Above 55 °C. The unit stops. Call service and find the cause before acknowledging it.
alarm.4.name: Fire risk — hot room air
alarm.5.help: Below 15 °C for ten minutes. The unit goes into its fault mode.
alarm.5.name: Cold extract air
alarm.6.help: Above 55 °C. The unit stops. Call service and find the cause before acknowledging it.
alarm.6.name: Fire risk — hot extract air
alarm.7.help: A fault reported by the heat pump.
alarm.7.name: Heat pump
alarm.8.help: From the after-heater’s power section. The alarm clears only once acknowledged.
alarm.8.name: Electric heater overheated
alarm.9.help: Below +8 °C. Applies to water coils. The alarm clears only once acknowledged.
alarm.9.name: Water coil — frost risk
clock.confirm.zone: The unit's clock agrees with yours, but Freeway Pi is %s out — Freeway Pi is probably set to the wrong timezone. Setting the unit's clock now would put it out by as much. Correct Freeway Pi's timezone instead.
error.admin.disabled: system control is not switched on (%s)
error.auth.nopin: no PIN has been set yet; set one in the interface first
error.boost.minutes: %d minutes is outside what the register list gives for boost, 1 to %d
error.clock.busy: the clock is already being set
error.clock.drift: the unit’s clock is %s out, and timer programmes fire by it. Set the clock first
error.clock.unchanged: the unit accepted the write, but its clock is still %s out. Try again, or set it on the control panel
error.clock.unreadable: the unit’s clock cannot be read, so a timer programme cannot be set safely
error.contenttype: the request has to be application/json
error.crosssite: the request came from another site
error.gateway.empty: the gateway lets nobody in without at least one address or subnet
error.helper.unreachable: the helper service does not answer: %s
error.history.off: the history is not being recorded
error.metrics.toomany: too many metrics in one request
error.modbus.address: the unit does not have this register (%s)
error.modbus.busy: the unit is busy; try again in a moment (%s)
error.modbus.failure: the unit could not answer the request (%s)
error.modbus.readonly: the unit refused the write. The register is most likely read-only — something it reports rather than something it can be told (%s)
error.modbus.value: the unit does not accept this value (%s)
error.name.toolong: the name may be at most 40 characters
error.network.address: a static configuration needs an address
error.network.netmask: the address needs a netmask, for instance 192.0.2.10/24
error.network.notenabled:
changing the network is not switched on (%s). Enable the helper service on Freeway Pi with:

error.network.unknown: “%s” is not an active network connection
error.overpressure.minutes: %d minutes is outside what the register list gives for overpressure, 1 to %d
error.program.fan: the fan level has to be between %d and %d %%
error.reboot.policy: choose being told or restarting automatically
error.setpoint.range: %.1f °C is outside the range the unit accepts, %.0f to %.0f
error.setting.twin: %s has a twin register that is not adjacent to it
error.smtp.incomplete: mail needs a server, a sender and at least one recipient
error.smtp.recipient: no recipient has been set for mail
error.unit.notread: the unit has not been read yet
error.wifi.country: the country code must be two letters, for example NO
error.wifi.psk: the password must be between 8 and 63 characters
error.wifi.rejected: the network rejected the passphrase — check that it is typed correctly
error.wifi.unsupported: this box has no wireless interface
helper.account.name: invalid user name
helper.firewall.off: the firewall is not in use
helper.revert.connection: the saved connection name is invalid
helper.revert.dns: the saved DNS addresses are invalid
helper.revert.ssid: the saved network name is invalid
helper.ssh.key.invalid: that does not look like a public ssh key
helper.ssh.key.none: there are no keys to remove
helper.ssh.key.notfound: found no key with that fingerprint
helper.ssh.key.unreadable: the key could not be read
helper.time.nontp: systemd-timesyncd is not in use on this box
helper.wifi.psk: the passphrase must be between 8 and 63 characters
helper.wifi.radio.failed: could not switch the radio on
link.down.detail: The unit has not answered several attempts.
link.errorrate.detail: %.0f %% of requests have to be repeated. Look at the cabling and the adapter.
link.incomplete.detail: Part of the last reading failed.
metric.bus_error_rate: Modbus requests that had to be repeated
note.apt.refresh: Looking for updates. It takes half a minute.
note.apt.upgrade: The upgrade is under way. It can take a few minutes.
note.clock.off: Switched off. The clock now has to be set by hand when it drifts.
note.clock.on: Switched on. Freeway Pi corrects the clock when it is more than %s out, and checks every %s. The change takes effect the next time the service restarts.
note.clock.scheduled: The clock will be set when the next minute begins, in %d seconds. The difference updates itself once it is done.
note.gateway.applied: Saved, and in use straight away.
note.name.cleared: Cleared — the unit is now called what its model says.
note.network.applied: Changed. Find Freeway Pi again on its new address and confirm within %s, or it goes back by itself.
note.poweroff: Freeway Pi is shutting down. It has to be started at the plug — the ventilation carries on without it, but control and logging stop.
note.reboot: Freeway Pi is restarting. The page comes back by itself in about a minute.
note.saved: Saved. The channels are in use straight away.
note.saved.restart: Saved. The change takes effect when the service is restarted.
note.time.restarting: The timezone has changed. Freeway Pi is starting again to use it — the page reloads in a moment.
note.wifi.joined: Connected. If Freeway Pi was already on wifi, find it again and confirm within %s, or it goes back by itself.
notify.clock.dst.message: Summer time has changed. The unit's clock is not adjusted automatically and cannot be set over Modbus, so it is now an hour out. Week and year programmes fire an hour off until it is set on the control panel.
notify.clock.dst.title: The unit's clock needs setting
notify.link.degraded.title: Unstable connection to the unit
notify.link.down.message: No contact for %s. The ventilation carries on with its own settings, but cannot be controlled or read from here.
notify.link.down.title: The unit is not answering
notify.power.message: Under-voltage measured %d times since boot. The supply or the cable is almost always the cause.
notify.power.title: Freeway Pi is not getting enough power
notify.reboot.title: A restart is needed after an update
notify.service.message: It has been %d days since the last one. Look the unit over and change the filters.
notify.service.title: Service is due
notify.skipped.nochannel: no notification channel is set up
notify.test.message: If you got this, the channel works.
notify.test.title: Test notification from Freeway Pi
program.function.away.help: Drops the fans to 30 %. No drop in energy use was measured on a heat-pump unit, because the pump works towards the same temperature either way.
program.function.away.label: Away
program.function.cooling_blocked.label: Cooling blocked
program.function.heating_blocked.label: Heating blocked
program.function.long_away.help: Drops the fans to 20 %. Same observation as for Away: on a heat-pump unit no drop in energy use was measured.
program.function.long_away.label: Long away
program.function.max_cooling.label: Max cooling
program.function.max_heating.label: Max heating
program.function.none.help: The programme is defined but does nothing.
program.function.none.label: None
program.function.relay.label: Time relay (DO)
program.function.temperature_drop.help: Lowers the setpoint by the amount set under Temperature.
program.function.temperature_drop.label: Temperature setback
reboot.required.title: A restart is needed after an update
setting.boost_level.help: Both fans are increased to this level. Factory setting 90 %.
setting.boost_level.label: Fan level
setting.boost_minutes.help: How long the boost function (also called forcing) lasts. The register list gives 0–60 minutes. Factory setting 30 min.
setting.boost_minutes.label: Duration
setting.cooling_allowed.label: Cooling allowed
setting.cooling_block_below.help: Cooling is blocked when the outdoor air is colder than this.
setting.cooling_block_below.label: Cooling blocked below
setting.heating_allowed.help: Persists across a power cycle. This is what keeps a heat pump from heating in summer.
setting.heating_allowed.label: Heating allowed
setting.heating_block_above.help: Heating is blocked when the outdoor air is warmer than this.
setting.heating_block_above.label: Heating blocked above
setting.measurement_refresh.help: How often the unit updates its own measurement registers. Lower gives fresher graphs and more work for the unit.
setting.measurement_refresh.label: Measurement register refresh
setting.overpressure_extract.label: Extract fan
setting.overpressure_minutes.help: How long overpressure runs. The register list gives 0–60 minutes, and the unit does not enforce it. Factory setting 10 min.
setting.overpressure_minutes.label: Duration
setting.overpressure_supply.help: The overpressure is the difference between this and the extract fan.
setting.overpressure_supply.label: Supply fan
setting.service_interval_days.label: Service interval
setting.service_reminder.label: Service reminder
setting.setpoint_max.label: Highest allowed setpoint
setting.setpoint_min.help: Narrows what may be asked for, on the unit and from here. The unit’s own range is narrower than the register list claims.
setting.setpoint_min.label: Lowest allowed setpoint
setting.temperature_drop.help: How far the setpoint drops when a timer programme asks for it. 0 switches the function off. The register list gives no upper limit and the unit enforces none; capped here at 10 °C.
setting.temperature_drop.label: Temperature setback
ui.alarm.log.help: The last twenty events, as the unit itself recorded them. The log lives in the unit and survives Freeway Pi being replaced or set up again.
ui.alarm.none.logged: The unit has nothing in its log.
ui.backup.help: The settings and the measurements in one file, with instructions for restoring it inside. The unit’s own settings live in the unit and survive Freeway Pi being replaced.
ui.bus.errorrate.help: The share of requests on the bus that had to be sent again. A few per thousand is healthy. A steady rise over days is what a connector working loose looks like, long before it becomes silence.
ui.clock.auto.help: Freeway Pi gets its own time from the internet and corrects the unit’s clock when it drifts. The clock drives the week and year programmes, and the unit has no daylight-saving adjustment — without this it has to be set by hand twice a year.
ui.clock.boxzone: Freeway Pi is set to the wrong timezone. The unit's clock matches yours, so its timer programmes run on time — but Freeway Pi is %s out. Correct the timezone, not the unit's clock.
ui.clock.drift: The unit’s clock is %s out, so week and year programmes fire at the wrong time.
ui.clock.drift.programs: The unit’s clock is %s out, and timer programmes fire by that clock.
ui.clock.dst: The clocks have changed. The unit’s clock is now an hour out, and week and year programmes fire an hour off.
ui.clock.dst.programs: The clocks have changed and the unit’s clock is not adjusted automatically. It is an hour out, so timer programmes fire an hour off.
ui.clock.ignored: %s An attempt to set it from here was accepted without the clock moving. Try again, or set it on the control panel.
ui.clock.panel.first: The unit’s clock has to be set on the control panel first
ui.clock.panel.only: %s This unit does not accept the clock being set over Modbus — it has to be set on the control panel.
ui.clock.wrong.still: The clock is still wrong. The programmes you save now will fire at the wrong time.
ui.command.failed: The command did not get through: %s
ui.data.empty: No measurements in this period yet. The history builds up while Freeway Pi runs — try a shorter period, or come back later.
ui.download.help: The measurements for the period above, as a spreadsheet. Semicolons and decimal commas, so Excel set up for a decimal comma reads it properly;
ui.download.help.tail: instead if it is going into something else.
ui.download.point: download with a point and a comma
ui.fan.running: Running at %s %% — fan speed increases automatically when the heat pump runs.
ui.gate.alarms: The alarm log needs a PIN.
ui.gate.programs: Week and year programmes need a PIN.
ui.gate.system: The system page needs a PIN.
ui.gateway.allow: Allowlist — one address or one subnet per line, in CIDR form
ui.gateway.closed: Off. Port %s is closed until the gateway is turned on.
ui.gateway.disabled: The Modbus gateway is switched off in the configuration.
ui.house.title: Air paths through the unit
ui.link.strip.degraded: Unstable connection to the unit. Some readings may be old, and a change may have to be made again.
ui.link.strip.down: No contact with the unit. Check the USB adapter and the RS-485 cable. The values shown are the last known ones, and changes are not getting through.
ui.link.unreachable: Cannot reach Freeway Pi. This page is showing what it remembers.
ui.name: Name
ui.net.confirm: Confirm — I can reach Freeway Pi
ui.net.notenabled: Changing the network is not switched on (%s). Enable the helper service with “sudo systemctl enable --now freeway-helper.socket”.
ui.net.pending: The network configuration has changed and is waiting to be confirmed. Confirm now, or Freeway Pi goes back to the old configuration by itself.
ui.net.revert: The change rolls itself back after %s seconds if you do not confirm it from the new address in time.
ui.net.which.help: Freeway Pi has more than one active connection. The one carrying traffic now is marked. You can give the wifi a fixed address here without disconnecting the wired connection. The wireless connection is used if the wired one is disconnected.
ui.notify.language: Notifications are written in %s — the language the interface was in when these settings were last saved. Switch the language at the top of the page and save again to change it.
ui.notify.log.none: Nothing has been reported in the last %s days.
ui.notread: the unit has not been read yet
ui.overpressure.help: When the unit ran overpressure. It also starts from a cooker hood or a central vacuum, and ends by itself when its minutes run out — so the band shows what actually happened, not only what somebody pressed.
ui.pin.card: Forgotten the PIN? Put “pin=1234” (where 1234 is the new PIN you want) in freeway.txt on the memory card’s boot partition. It is set on the next boot, with no old PIN required.
ui.pin.changed: The PIN has been changed. Every other login has ended.
ui.pin.first: The settings are unprotected until you set a PIN. Choose one now — it can be digits or a longer password.
ui.pin.help: The PIN locks settings, timer programmes and the system page. Everyday use (temperature, fan, mode) does not need it.
ui.pin.mismatch: The two new PINs do not match.
ui.pin.private: The PIN never leaves this device. The browser proves it knows it without sending it.
ui.pin.remember: You stay logged in on this device for 90 days.
ui.pin.shape: The PIN must be between 4 and 12 digits.
ui.power.help: Restart and shut down apply to Freeway Pi, not to the unit. The ventilation carries on either way — it is control, logging and the Modbus gateway that stop while it is down.
ui.power.notenabled: Restarting from here is not switched on (%s). Enable the helper service with “sudo systemctl enable --now freeway-helper.socket”.
ui.power.off.warn: Freeway Pi shuts down and can only be started at the plug. The ventilation carries on, but control, logging and the Modbus gateway are gone until somebody switches it on again.
ui.power.restart.warn: Freeway Pi restarts. Control, logging and the Modbus gateway are down for about a minute. The ventilation carries on without it.
ui.power.strip: Freeway Pi is not getting enough power – %s under-voltage events since boot. Change the supply or the cable: under-voltage corrupts the memory card and causes random restarts.
ui.power.strip.once: Freeway Pi is not getting enough power – one under-voltage event since boot. If more follow, change the supply or the cable: under-voltage corrupts the memory card and causes random restarts.
ui.program.idle: No timer programme is in effect now
ui.program.none.cover: It is %s on the unit, and none of the programmes covers that moment.
ui.program.none.set: No programme has a function set.
ui.program.remove.confirm: %s will be removed from the unit. What is in it is lost, but you can set up a new one.
ui.program.running: A timer programme is in effect now
ui.program.unit.time: The unit believes the time is %s, and the programmes run by it.
ui.program.week.none: No week programmes have been set up.
ui.program.year.none: No year programmes have been set up.
ui.programs.help: The unit has no single on/off for timer programmes. A programme is in use when it has a function.
ui.reading.supply.target: The supply air is aimed at
ui.reboot.policy: When an update needs a restart
ui.save.name: Save
ui.service.next: Next service in %s days — %s days since the last one, of an interval of %s.
ui.service.off: The reminder is off, so the unit is not counting down to anything. The counter still reads %s days since the last service.
ui.service.overdue: Service is %s days overdue. %s days since the last one, of an interval of %s.
ui.smtp.help: Needs an SMTP server to send the mail. The password for an external SMTP server is stored on Freeway Pi.
ui.smtp.password.kept: stored — leave it to keep it
ui.ssh.card: It can also be opened at boot by putting “ssh=10” (minutes) or “ssh=permanent” in freeway.txt on the memory card’s boot partition.
ui.ssh.help.closed: SSH is closed. There is normally no need for SSH access to Freeway Pi, but it can be opened for 30 minutes or permanently when needed.
ui.ssh.key.remove.confirm: Remove the key “%s”? It will not be able to log in afterwards.
ui.ssh.nofirewall: The firewall is not in use, so SSH is open and cannot be closed from here. Run harden.sh on Freeway Pi first.
ui.ssh.nokeys: No keys are installed, so nobody can log in over SSH — not even with the port open. Paste a public key below, or put “ssh-key=…” in freeway.txt on the memory card.
ui.ssh.nokeys.open: The SSH port is open, but no key is installed, so nobody can log in. Paste a public key below, or put “ssh-key=…” in freeway.txt on the memory card.
ui.ssh.warn.close: Close SSH? If freewayd stops answering, the only way in is taking the memory card out and writing freeway.txt on it, or connecting a keyboard and a screen.
ui.ssh.warn.perm: Open SSH permanently? The port stays reachable to everything on the network. Logging in needs a key, so the risk is small on a home network — but it is larger than opening it when you need it.
ui.stale: The unit is not answering. The values below are the last known ones.
ui.stop.confirm: This stops the fans completely. There is no ventilation in the house until you switch them on again. Are you sure?
ui.time.help: The timezone decides what is written to the unit's clock. Time servers may be left empty for the default; separate several with spaces.
ui.time.mismatch: Your browser is in %s and Freeway Pi is in something else. It is Freeway Pi's timezone that is written to the unit's clock — and so the one the week and year programmes follow.
ui.timed.unknown: Running. It began before Freeway Pi was watching, so the time left is unknown.
ui.undervoltage.help: Periods when the kernel reported the 5 V supply dropping below the limit. The resolution is half a minute, so the band shows when and how often it happened — the exact count is under Health on the system page. That count starts again at each restart, so you can change the supply or the cable, restart Freeway Pi, and see whether it helped.
ui.unit.name: Name
ui.unit.name.label: Name of the unit
ui.upd.counting.long: Counting pending updates. It takes about fifteen seconds on this hardware.
ui.upd.failed: The last run failed. The log below says why.
ui.upd.notenabled: Updating from here is not switched on (%s). Automatic updates carry on regardless; these are only the buttons that do it at once.
ui.upd.refreshed: Done — the list below is up to date.
ui.upd.running: The upgrade is running. It can take a few minutes, and the page is following along.
ui.webhook.none: No webhook has been set up. A webhook gives your own system a push, and lets you build on it there.
ui.wifi.cable: Wifi can also be set up by putting “wifi-ssid=MyNetwork”, “wifi-psk=YourPassphrase” and “wifi-country=NO” on separate lines in freeway.txt on the memory card’s boot partition.
ui.wifi.country.missing: The country is not set. The radio stays blocked until it is, and a scan finds nothing — which looks like broken hardware but is only a question nobody answered.
ui.wifi.forget.confirm: Forget the network “%s”? Freeway Pi will need the password again to reconnect.
ui.wifi.joined.nocable: Connected. Freeway Pi is on a cable, so this change cannot take it away from you — it needs no confirmation.
ui.wifi.notconnected: Not connected to any wireless network
ui.wifi.open.warning: Open network. Traffic goes unencrypted over the air.
ui.wifi.pending: The wifi change is waiting to be confirmed. Confirm now, or Freeway Pi goes back to the network it was on.
ui.wifi.radio.off: The radio is switched off in NetworkManager. The hardware is fine — Freeway Pi simply finds nothing while the switch is off.
ui.wifi.standby: Wifi is connected, but Freeway Pi is on a wired connection. Lose it and it moves here: %s. Anything speaking Modbus TCP to the fixed address then has to be repointed, or point at the hostname.
ui.wifi.unsupported: This box has no wireless interface. It runs on a cable.
